node.label: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 2
node.definition: A condition associated with mutation(s) in the TPP1 gene, encoding tripeptidyl-peptidase- 1. The condition is one of a group of genetically heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorders, characterized by accumulation of intracellular lipopigments.
synonyms: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis caused by mutation in TPP1
